positive.description: Reads the signed-in user's personalized feed and reports what is new in developer news.
positive.prompt: What's happening in developer news today?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of recent articles from the user's personalized For You feed, each with a title, publisher and link, summarized in a short rundown.

positive.description: Searches the daily.dev index of third-party developer articles by topic.
positive.prompt: Find recent articles about Rust async runtimes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching articles with titles, publishers and URLs. If nothing matches, it says so rather than inventing results.

positive.prompt: What have I saved to read later?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the articles bookmarked on the account, newest first, with titles and links.

positive.description: Write path: finds an article and saves it to the user's bookmarks.
positive.prompt: Find a recent article about PostgreSQL performance and save it to my bookmarks.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a matching article, saves it, and confirms which article was saved. Re-running 'What have I saved to read later?' then shows it at the top of the list.

positive.description: Write path: changes the user's feed settings by following a topic.
positive.prompt: Follow the kubernetes topic in my feed.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds kubernetes to the followed tags and confirms. Asking 'What topics am I following?' then calls getFeedsFilters and lists kubernetes among them.

negative.description: Out-of-scope write to an unrelated third-party service. daily.dev exposes no tool that writes anywhere outside the user's daily.dev account.
negative.prompt: Save this article to my Notion workspace instead.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines and explains it can only save articles to daily.dev bookmarks. It does not claim to have written anything to Notion.

negative.description: Arbitrary URL retrieval. The tools search an index of articles daily.dev has already ingested; they cannot fetch and read a URL on demand.
negative.prompt: Fetch https://example.com/some-article and summarize the full text for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it can only work with articles indexed by daily.dev, and offers to search the index instead. It does not fabricate a summary of the page.

negative.description: Unsupported engagement action. The public API has no upvote, comment or share tool, only reads of existing comments.
negative.prompt: Upvote that post and leave a comment saying thanks.
negative.expected_behavior: Says upvoting and commenting are not available through this connection and suggests doing it on daily.dev. It does not report a successful upvote or comment.
